usage.summary: Classifies one board intersection of a photo as empty, black or white.
usage.geometry: Warp the photo onto a square grid with neighbouring intersections 32 px apart. Warp at 4x that size, then shrink with area interpolation, so thin grid lines don't alias away.
usage.patch: 32x32 px of the warped image, centred on the intersection.
usage.rotation: Any: stones look the same from every side, so the board may be seen from any side.
usage.video: Debounce each intersection over a few frames: glare can show a false white for 1-2 frames.
